searches.name: 2021-2023 BMW M5
searches.notes: Imported from the SEARCH_URL repository secret. The year range is also enforced here because the new AutoScout24 platform no longer honours the yRng parameter in the original link - a live run returned 2014 and 2027 cars for it. The link's own 'near V6N 3B5' is ignored by the new platform too - it was returning Ontario, Alberta and Quebec cars - so the distance is enforced here instead, at 250 km: the Lower Mainland, the Fraser Valley and Vancouver Island.

searches.name: BMW M5 bargains (any year)
searches.notes: A wider net on the same car: any year, Canada-wide, with the price ceiling applied by the bot rather than by the search link. Remove it in the dashboard if you only want the 2021-2023 watch. Read to the end of the results rather than the first three pages: autotrader.ca rotates which listings surface, so sampling 60 of 186 gave a different 60 every run and made cars look like they had been sold.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.help: Message @BotFather -> /newbot to get a token, then message your new bot once and open https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates to read your chat id.

discord.label: Discord
discord.help: Server Settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks -> New Webhook -> Copy URL.

ntfy.label: ntfy
ntfy.help: Install the ntfy app, subscribe to a topic nobody can guess, and put that topic name in Settings. No account needed.

slack.label: Slack
slack.help: Create a Slack app -> Incoming Webhooks -> Add New Webhook.

email.label: Email (Gmail)
email.help: Turn on 2-Step Verification, then create an App Password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.

webhook.label: Custom webhook
webhook.help: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST.

twilio.label: SMS (Twilio)
twilio.help: Costs money per message and per phone number. Telegram or ntfy give you the same phone alert for free.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.help: Message @BotFather -> /newbot to get a token, then message your new bot once and open https://api.telegram.org/bot<TOKEN>/getUpdates to read your chat id.

discord.label: Discord
discord.help: Server Settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks -> New Webhook -> Copy URL.

ntfy.label: ntfy
ntfy.help: Install the ntfy app, subscribe to a topic nobody can guess, and put that topic name in Settings. No account needed.

slack.label: Slack
slack.help: Create a Slack app -> Incoming Webhooks -> Add New Webhook.

email.label: Email (Gmail)
email.help: Turn on 2-Step Verification, then create an App Password at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords.

webhook.label: Custom webhook
webhook.help: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST.

twilio.label: SMS (Twilio)
twilio.help: Costs money per message and per phone number. Telegram or ntfy give you the same phone alert for free.

searches.name: 2021-2023 BMW M5
searches.notes: Imported from the SEARCH_URL repository secret. The year range is also enforced here because the new AutoScout24 platform no longer honours the yRng parameter in the original link - a live run returned 2014 and 2027 cars for it. The link's own 'near V6N 3B5' is ignored by the new platform too - it was returning Ontario, Alberta and Quebec cars - so the distance is enforced here instead, at 250 km: the Lower Mainland, the Fraser Valley and Vancouver Island.

searches.name: BMW M5 bargains (any year)
searches.notes: A wider net on the same car: any year, Canada-wide, with the price ceiling applied by the bot rather than by the search link. Remove it in the dashboard if you only want the 2021-2023 watch. Read to the end of the results rather than the first three pages: autotrader.ca rotates which listings surface, so sampling 60 of 186 gave a different 60 every run and made cars look like they had been sold.
